The vendor directly providing **Crowdcast** at **crowdcast.io** is **Crowdcast, Inc.**

### Evidence
According to the official **Terms of Service** governing `crowdcast.io`:
> *"Please read these Terms of Service (the “Terms”) and our Privacy Policy (“Privacy Policy”) carefully because they govern your use of the website located at https://crowdcast.io/ (the “Site”) and our live video platform services accessible via the Site and corresponding mobile application (“App”) offered by Crowdcast, Inc. (“Crowdcast”)."*

This is additionally corroborated by the **Privacy Policy** at `crowdcast.io`:
> *"Crowdcast, Inc. (“Crowdcast”, “we”, “us” or “our”) provides a live streaming platform that allows users to host live, online events."*

record.description: Crowdcast is a live-streaming platform that revolutionizes webinars and virtual conferences by emphasizing user engagement and analytics. It provides a seamless experience for hosting events with features like interactive Q&A, live polling, and instant video replies. Participants can engage actively during sessions, while organizers benefit from detailed analytics including participant data and event insights. Known for facilitating large-scale events, Crowdcast aims to enhance the overall quality and effectiveness of online gatherings for businesses.
